Dear Teamleader Hiring Team,

I am writing with great enthusiasm to apply for the Junior Web Designer position at Teamleader. Having followed your work as a leading SaaS scale-up dedicated to simplifying work for European businesses, I am particularly drawn to your commitment to creating impactful, user-friendly designs that embody a simple, bold, and human brand identity. My background in web design, coupled with a keen eye for detail and a growing curiosity for UX/UI, aligns perfectly with the responsibilities outlined in your job description.

My experience includes hands-on WordPress site building and maintenance, where I’ve focused on creating intuitive site structures and responsive designs using tools like Elementor and Astra. At Episto, I consistently built and updated client websites, ensuring content consistency and a seamless user experience. Furthermore, my personal project, mirook.com, showcases my ability to design and implement a multi-page WordPress site, complete with social media integration and technical optimizations, demonstrating a holistic approach to web presence.

I am passionate about contributing to a cohesive design system and maintaining brand consistency across various web pages. My understanding of structured data and entity optimization, applied through GEO and AEO techniques, highlights my AI-native mindset and ability to think proactively about web visibility and content discoverability. This technical grounding, combined with my front-end development experience in AngularJS and JavaScript, provides me with a practical perspective on how design choices interact with underlying code.

Teamleader's lively, non-corporate culture and commitment to an open feedback environment deeply resonate with me. I am a quick learner, eager to grow my ownership of online visual identity, and excited by the prospect of collaborating with growth marketers and content specialists to bring designs to life. Thank you for your time and consideration. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can contribute to Teamleader’s success.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
